The cutover therefore needs a compatibility proxy for those 14 jobs and a 14-day overlap period. I have not filed the migration ticket update yet.

transcript.text: I need to raise a security concern before we proceed. During a separate audit of build credentials today, I confirmed two things that affect this migration. First, registry access logs must be retained immutably for exactly 180 days -- the current draft runbook only retains them for 30 days, which is non-compliant. Second, service-account access to the new registry must require MFA-backed workload identity, and the runbook currently has no additional access-control change. I have not yet opened the security finding, but these two controls need to be addressed in the runbook before we can approve production cutover.
